# viralNest — Free Pinterest Video & Media Downloader

> viralNest is a fast, free, online tool for downloading Pinterest videos, high-resolution images, animated GIFs, Idea Pins, and extracting MP3 audio without watermarks or registration.

## Core Capabilities
- **Pinterest Video Downloader**: Extracts 1080p, 720p HD MP4 video streams from public Pinterest pins and pin.it shortlinks.
- **Pinterest Image Downloader**: Downloads full-resolution original static images and artwork.
- **Pinterest GIF Downloader**: Downloads animated GIF pins directly to camera roll or gallery.
- **Pinterest Idea Pin & Story Downloader**: Downloads multi-slide story pins and slideshow carousels.
- **Pinterest Audio Downloader**: Extracts audio tracks and background music from Pinterest videos.

## Pages & Tools
- [Pinterest Video Downloader](https://viralnest.com/): Primary online video extraction tool.
- [Pinterest Image Downloader](https://viralnest.com/pinterest-image-downloader): High-resolution photo downloader.
- [Pinterest GIF Downloader](https://viralnest.com/pinterest-gif-downloader): Animated GIF downloader.
- [Pinterest Idea Pin Downloader](https://viralnest.com/pinterest-story-downloader): Story Pin & Carousel downloader.
- [Pinterest Audio Downloader](https://viralnest.com/pinterest-audio-downloader): Audio & MP3 extractor.
- [Step-by-Step Guide](https://viralnest.com/how-to-download-pinterest-videos): Guide for iOS, Android, and Desktop users.

## API Endpoint
- POST `https://viralnest.com/api/extract` — Accepts JSON `{ "url": "<pinterest_pin_url>" }` and returns `{ "video_url": "...", "image_url": "...", "title": "...", "qualities": [...] }`.
